description: Header file defining external facades and helper functions for entity management in the Unvanquished game, including team checks, health status, and damage functions.

classes.name: Entity
classes.description: Forward declaration of the Entity class used in entity-related functions.

methods.name: OnSameTeam
methods.description: Checks if two entities are assigned to the same team.

methods.name: OnOpposingTeams
methods.description: Checks if two entities are assigned to opposing teams.

methods.name: IsAlive
methods.description: Determines if an entity is alive (has health and is not dead).

methods.name: IsDead
methods.description: Determines if an entity is dead.

methods.name: HasHealthComponent
methods.description: Checks if an entity has a health component.

methods.name: HealthOf
methods.description: Returns the health value of an entity.

methods.name: HasFullHealth
methods.description: Checks if an entity is at full health.

methods.name: HealthFraction
methods.description: Returns the fraction of health remaining for an entity.

methods.name: Kill
methods.description: Deals damage to kill an entity, with overloads for different entity types.

methods.name: AntiHumanRadiusDamage
methods.description: Applies radius damage to an entity, likely against human units.

methods.name: KnockbackRadiusDamage
methods.description: Applies radius damage with knockback effect.
